onboarding.welcome_desc: Pose any "what if" question and watch a swarm of AI agents debate, deliberate, and surface alternate worldlines. Here are the four core gameplay modes plus a peek at the advanced toolkit.
onboarding.roundtable_desc: Multiple representatives gather around a virtual table to debate divergent futures. Steer the conversation, switch panelists, and watch consensus form (or fracture) in real time.
onboarding.chamber_desc: Step into a private room with a single agent for a deep, focused dialogue. Ask follow-ups, anchor quotes, and excavate the reasoning behind a chosen worldline.
onboarding.one_move_desc: Change just one decision and replay the simulation to feel the butterfly effect. Compare branches side by side to see how a single nudge ripples across timelines.
onboarding.advanced_desc: Build your own agents, explore causal graphs, replay traces, and analyze emergent factions. Look for the workshop, graph workbench, and counterfactual panels once a scenario is running.
